name: Cookies Addons Fields
description: COOKiES add-on that withholds an individual entity field behind cookie consent via a per-formatter setting on Manage display, showing a placeholder and AJAX-loading the field (with full entity/field access checks) once the matching cookies service is accepted.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Adds a Cookies service selector to every field formatter's third-party settings on Manage display; a field with a service set is replaced by a placeholder until the visitor consents, then AJAX-loaded. The render route re-checks entity view access, field view access and the view mode before returning the field. Requires the Cookies Addons module.
